extensions.consequence: Device-time attribution unavailable on the pinned profile; 1x1 readPixels barrier remains the only attribution tool.

backdropCopyFromScreen.note: copyTexSubImage2D into RGBA8 from the alpha:false default framebuffer silently copies nothing (all bytes differ from the blit); into RGB8 it is exact but 2x slower. The current flipped blit is already the cheapest copy.

fixedFunctionPrimitiveBlend.analysis: Primitive source-over s+floor(d*(256-a)/256) cannot be one fixed-function pass: the floor needs a negative source bias, clamped to zero for s=0 (black text). Two passes (reverse-subtract with bias 0.5-1/512 then add) are exact in float32 but need ~7.7e-6 absolute margin, unsafe for fp16 blending, and cost two GL blend passes (~2.25 ms each per full frame) against blit plus exact shader (~4.7 ms).

storyInstancesAttribution.conclusion: Upload plus owned-byte copy alone (327 ms) exceed the 290 ms budget before any GPU composition; SVG/image raster reuse cannot close the case.
